entities.name: Orodes II of Elymais
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Orodes II of Elymais, also known as Kamnaskires-Orodes, was the ruler of Elymais in the late 1st century. He was the son and successor of Orodes I, and was himself succeeded by a certain Phraates.
